notes.title: Demo - QoL Changes #3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Not affordable skillnodes will shake, when trying to purchase them
[*] Chat messages are now fully localized
[*] The DPS Meter will now calculate the actual DPS and not the total raid damage
[/list]

notes.title: Demo - QoL Changes #2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Set default language to english, if the OS (Operating System) language is not supported by the game
[*] Refresh skillnodes while the skilltree is open, to reflect if a node is affordable
[*] Special skillnodes (those with blue border) will now have green or red borders, when affordable or not
[*] [Hold to buy max. rank] progressbar is now faster
[/list]

notes.title: Demo - QoL Changes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [Hold to buy max. rank] will only work, if the skill is not maxed out yet
[*] Adjusted the steam page redirect link, inside the "Raid" Tab
[/list]
